Container.Name: OpenSEO
Container.Overview:
OpenSEO is an open-source, self-hosted alternative to Semrush and Ahrefs. It provides a focused, modern toolkit for keyword research, SERP analysis, backlink discovery, and site audits with a pay-as-you-go architecture (bring your own DataForSEO API key). Also features native Model Context Protocol (MCP) and AI SEO agent integration (SAM) for Claude Code, OpenClaw, and ChatGPT.
[b]Key Features:[/b] - [b]Keyword Research & SERPs:[/b] Real-time search volumes, keyword difficulty, search intent, and live SERP rank tracking. - [b]Backlink Analysis:[/b] Audit referring domains, anchor text distribution, and link authority. - [b]Site Audits:[/b] Comprehensive technical SEO crawler checking broken links, meta tags, redirects, and Core Web Vitals. - [b]AI Agent Integration (MCP):[/b] Connect AI coding assistants and use SAM (in-app SEO assistant powered by OpenRouter). - [b]Pay-As-You-Go:[/b] No expensive monthly subscriptions; pay only for what you query using your own DataForSEO API credentials. - [b]Privacy & Self-Hosted:[/b] All research data and local databases remain securely on your server.
[b]Initial Setup:[/b] 1. Set [b]AUTH_MODE[/b] to [inline]local_noauth[/inline] for local trusted network access (auto-logs in as admin@localhost), or use [inline]cloudflare_access[/inline] for Cloudflare Zero Trust. 2. Provide your [b]DATAFORSEO_API_KEY[/b] in the template settings or enter it directly inside the web UI. 3. Open [inline]http://[IP]:[PORT:3001]/[/inline] after starting the container.
[b]Credits & Support:[/b] - OpenSEO is created by [b]Ben Senescu / every-app[/b] ([url=https://github.com/every-app/open-seo]GitHub[/url] | [url=https://openseo.so]Website[/url]). - The donation link below specifically supports the maintenance of this Unraid template repository.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: The port for the OpenSEO web interface (internal container port is 3001).

Config.Name: AppData
Config.Description: Storage path for local database and configuration files.

Config.Name: DataForSEO API Key
Config.Description: DataForSEO API key (Base64 login:password). Required for live keyword search, SERP data, and backlink analysis.

Config.Name: Authentication Mode
Config.Description: Authentication mode: 'local_noauth' for local trusted network (admin@localhost auto-login), 'cloudflare_access' for Cloudflare Access Zero Trust, or 'hosted' for email/password.

Config.Name: Allowed Host
Config.Description: Optional domain name or IP used to access OpenSEO when running behind a reverse proxy (e.g. seo.yourdomain.com).

Config.Name: OpenRouter API Key
Config.Description: Optional OpenRouter API key for SAM, the in-app AI SEO assistant.

Config.Name: OpenRouter Model
Config.Description: Model identifier for the AI assistant.

Config.Name: Disable Telemetry
Config.Description: Set to 'true' to disable anonymous usage heartbeat telemetry.

Config.Name: Better Auth Secret
Config.Description: Random secret (32+ characters) used to encrypt stored OAuth credentials (required for Google Search Console).

Config.Name: Google Client ID
Config.Description: Optional Google OAuth Client ID for Google Search Console integration.

Config.Name: Google Client Secret
Config.Description: Optional Google OAuth Client Secret for Google Search Console integration.

Config.Name: Cloudflare Include Process Env
Config.Description: Exposes Compose/Docker environment variables to cloudflare:workers runtime bindings.
